name: Kinami Mizuki
source:
Likes: Fried Mackerel
Hobby: Playing Go

2nd year high school student.
Since she was a child she's been able to see things that other people can't, obeying her mother's orders she's kept that ability hidden from others.
She's not good at being in the spotlight but she holds her own opinions of things and has a strong spirit.
